The child_process usage is plausibly used to launch local sound players, and the os.userInfo() call is used only to create a per-user temporary deduplication file. The static rule hits for system fingerprinting and detached background execution look like false positives in this context. No secrets, credential harvesting, network exfiltration, obfuscation, or remote-control behavior is visible in this excerpt. The main residual uncertainty is that the full file is not available, so the exact commands passed to spawn() cannot be confirmed.
